title: GTA 6 at The Game Awards 2026: All 8 Nominations, Rivals and Odds
desc: GTA 6 has 8 nominations at The Game Awards 2026, the most of any game. Every category, every rival, our odds, the record it can't break, and how to watch on Dec 10.
lede: GTA 6 is up for 8 awards at The Game Awards 2026, more than any other game, including Game of the Year. The show is Thursday, December 10, at 7:30 PM ET (4:30 PM PT) from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Below: every category, who GTA 6 is up against, and our odds. Our call is 6 of 8. No story spoilers.

S = lock, A = likely, B = coin flip. The odds are our opinion; the nominee lists come from the official list as reported by Game Informer, GameSpot and Dexerto.
Why it's the favorite for Game of the Year
99 on Metacritic, 118 perfect scores out of 147 critic reviews on PS5 in launch week, and more nominations than any other game. It was even nominated on November 17, two days before it launched.

The record for most wins in one night is 9, set by Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 at The Game Awards 2025. GTA 6 is nominated in 8 categories, so even a clean sweep can't beat it. Eight wins would still be the second most ever, ahead of the 7 The Last of Us Part II won in 2020.
How to watch and how winners are picked
The show streams free on YouTube, Twitch and Facebook, and on Disney+ for the first time. Winners are picked 90% by a jury and 10% by a public fan vote.
Manni L. Perez is nominated for Best Performance as Lucia. Rockstar never announced the casting: the nominee list is how most fans found out.
note: We'll update this page with the winners on the night of December 10.
faq: Is GTA 6 nominated for Game of the Year?
Yes. Its rivals are 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem and Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
How many Game Awards nominations does GTA 6 have?
Eight, the most of any game in 2026.
Thursday, December 10, 2026, 7:30 PM ET / 4:30 PM PT, at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.
Can GTA 6 break the Game Awards record?
No. The record is 9 wins (Clair Obscur, 2025) and GTA 6 is nominated in 8 categories.
Manni L. Perez, nominated for Best Performance.
